strata.heading: Strata — Archive Strata
strata.description: Stratified by type — each band represents one artwork category. Band thickness reflects the number of works. X axis is year of creation.
strata.gapNote: Record time ≠ creation time. 85 of 87 history rows were written in a few weeks of 2026.

markets.heading: Markets — Currency Distribution
markets.description: Each dot is one sold edition; radius scales with log price. One column per currency present in the data, sorted by transaction count.

terminal.heading: Terminal — Archive Output
terminal.description: System output as art object. Missing fields are shown as ─, not hidden.

diaspora.heading: Diaspora
diaspora.description: The studio sits at the centre; works radiate outward to 21 locations. Node size scales with edition count.
diaspora.stateHint: The archive is thin. Location-flow data will grow as the system gets used.

pin.viewAll: View all editions at this location →
pin.unpinHint: Click node again or click empty area to unpin
